passages.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to look at the mountains of Israel.
He commanded me to speak a prophecy against the mountains of Israel.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל־ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהִנָּבֵ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: You are to say: ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel is a prophet.
God told Ezekiel to speak to the land of Israel.
God said, "Mountains of Israel, listen to the word of the Lord GOD."
God spoke to the mountains, the hills, the ravines, and the valleys.
God said, "I am bringing a sword against you."
God said, "I will destroy your high places."
passages.original: וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְ֠הוִה לֶהָרִ֨ים וְלַגְּבָע֜וֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֣ים וְלַגֵּאָיֹת הִנְנִ֨י אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵיכֶם֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְאִבַּדְתִּ֖י בָּמֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God will destroy their altars.
God will break their incense altars.
God will throw the bodies of their dead people in front of their idols.
passages.original: וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ מִזְבְּח֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם וְנִשְׁבְּר֖וּ חַמָּֽנֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִפַּלְתִּי֙ חַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will lay the corpses of the Israelites before their idols and scatter your bones around your altars.
passages.sermon: God is speaking to the people of Israel.\r\nGod says, "I will lay the dead bodies of the Israelites in front of their idols."\r\nI will scatter your bones around your altars.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֗י אֶת־ פִּגְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֑ם וְזֵרִיתִי֙ אֶת־ עַצְמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם סְבִיב֖וֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Wherever you live, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and desecrated, your idols smashed and obliterated, your incense altars cut down, and your works blotted out.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
He warns them about judgment for their idolatry.
Wherever you live, your cities will become ruins.
Your high places will be destroyed.
Your altars will be laid waste.
Your altars will be desecrated.
Your idols will be smashed.
Your idols will be obliterated.
Your incense altars will be cut down.
All your works will be wiped out.
passages.original: בְּכֹל֙ מוֹשְׁב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם הֶעָרִ֣ים תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְהַבָּמ֖וֹת תִּישָׁ֑מְנָה לְמַעַן֩ יֶחֶרְב֨וּ וְיֶאְשְׁמ֜וּ מִזְבְּחֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְנִשְׁבְּר֤וּ וְנִשְׁבְּתוּ֙ גִּלּ֣וּלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנִגְדְּעוּ֙ חַמָּ֣נֵיכֶ֔ם וְנִמְח֖וּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God will act among the Israelites.
People will die among the Israelites.
You will see the slain among you.
You will know that I am the LORD.
passages.original: וְנָפַ֥ל חָלָ֖ל בְּתֽוֹכְכֶ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Yet I will leave a remnant, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the nations and throughout the lands.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says He will leave a remnant.
Some people will survive.
Some people will escape death by the sword.
These survivors will be scattered among the nations.
They will live in many different lands.
passages.original: וְהוֹתַרְתִּ֗י בִּהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֛ם פְּלִ֥יטֵי חֶ֖רֶב בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם בְּהִזָּרֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then in the nations to which they have been carried captive, your survivors will remember Me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts that turned away from Me, and by their eyes that lusted after idols. So they will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their abominations.
passages.sermon:
God sent the people of Israel into exile among the nations.
Some people survived captivity in those nations.
These survivors will remember God.
God grieved because their hearts were unfaithful and turned away from Him.
Their eyes desired idols instead of God.
The survivors will feel disgusted with themselves.
They will hate the evil things they did.
They will hate all their abominations.
passages.original: וְזָכְר֨וּ פְלִֽיטֵיכֶ֜ם אוֹתִ֗י בַּגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ־ שָׁם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֜רְתִּי אֶת־ לִבָּ֣ם הַזּוֹנֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ סָר֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י וְאֵת֙ עֵֽינֵיהֶ֔ם הַזֹּנ֕וֹת אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָקֹ֙טּוּ֙ בִּפְנֵיהֶ֔ם אֶל־ הָֽרָעוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ לְכֹ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not declare in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God spoke about bringing calamity to the people of Israel.
God did not speak these words for no reason.
God will do what He said.
The people will know that God is the LORD.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֤א אֶל־ חִנָּם֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָהֶ֖ם הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃פ

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: Clap your hands, stomp your feet, and cry out “Alas!” because of all the wicked abominations of the house of Israel, who will fall by sword and famine and plague.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He commands a message.
Clap your hands.
Stomp your feet.
Cry out, “Alas!”
The house of Israel has done wicked abominations.
They will fall by the sword.
They will fall by famine.
They will fall by plague.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הַכֵּ֨ה בְכַפְּךָ֜ וּרְקַ֤ע בְּרַגְלְךָ֙ וֶֽאֱמָר־ אָ֔ח אֶ֛ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲב֥וֹת רָע֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֗ר בַּחֶ֛רֶב בָּרָעָ֥ב וּבַדֶּ֖בֶר יִפֹּֽלוּ׃

passages.text: He who is far off will die by the plague, he who is near will fall by the sword, and he who remains will die by famine. So I will vent My fury upon them.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking about the people of Israel.
Some people are far away.
These people will die by the plague.
Some people are near.
These people will fall by the sword.
Some people remain and are under siege.
These people will die by famine.
God will pour out His fury on them.
passages.original: הָרָח֞וֹק בַּדֶּ֣בֶר יָמ֗וּת וְהַקָּרוֹב֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפּ֔וֹל וְהַנִּשְׁאָר֙ וְהַנָּצ֔וּר בָּרָעָ֖ב יָמ֑וּת וְכִלֵּיתִ֥י חֲמָתִ֖י בָּֽם׃

passages.text: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when their slain lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, and under every green tree and leafy oak—the places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is the God of Israel.
You will know that I am the Lord.
You will see the dead bodies of the people.
Their bodies will lie among their idols.
Their bodies will be around their altars.
You will see this on every high hill.
You will see this on every mountaintop.
You will see this under every green tree.
You will see this under every leafy oak.
These are the places where the people offered incense to their idols.
They burned incense to false gods in these places.
passages.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בִּֽהְי֣וֹת חַלְלֵיהֶ֗ם בְּתוֹךְ֙ גִּלּ֣וּלֵיהֶ֔ם סְבִיב֖וֹת מִזְבְּחֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם אֶל֩ כָּל־ גִּבְעָ֨ה רָמָ֜ה בְּכֹ֣ל׀ רָאשֵׁ֣י הֶהָרִ֗ים וְתַ֨חַת כָּל־ עֵ֤ץ רַֽעֲנָן֙ וְתַ֙חַת֙ כָּל־ אֵלָ֣ה עֲבֻתָּ֔ה מְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ־ שָׁם֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ לְכֹ֖ל גִּלּוּלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will stretch out My hand against them, and wherever they live I will make the land a desolate waste, from the wilderness to Diblah. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act with power.
The LORD will stretch out His hand against the people.
The LORD will make the land empty and ruined.
The LORD will do this in every place where the people live.
The LORD will make the land a waste from the wilderness to Diblah.
The people will know that the LORD is God.
passages.original: וְנָטִ֤יתִי אֶת־ יָדִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶת־ הָאָ֜רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֤ה וּמְשַׁמָּה֙ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר דִּבְלָ֔תָה בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
